title: A Potential Lead for Insect Growth Regulator: Design, Synthesis, and Biological Activity Evaluation of Novel Hexacyclic Pyrazolamide Derivatives.
authors: Guo, Bingbo; Jiang, Biaobiao; Wang, Chunying; Jin, Xiaoyu; Wang, Liuyang; Yang, Zhaokai; Luo, Shihui; Yang, Qing; Zhang, Li; Yang, Xinling
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成昆虫生长调节剂并做杀虫活性评价，虽含分子对接但对象为EcR受体与几丁质酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ecdysone receptor (EcR) and chitinase play a critical role in the molting stage of insect pests. Each of them is considered a promising target for the development of novel insect growth regulators (IGRs). In the present paper, a total of 24 (23 novel) hexacyclic pyrazolamide derivatives were designed and synthesized by reducing the heptacycle and inserting small flexible linkers on the basis of the previously discovered dual-target compound D-27 acting simultaneously on EcR and Ostrinia furnacalis chitinase (OfChtI). Their insecticidal activities against Plutella xylostella, Spodoptera frugiperda, and Ostrinia furnacalis larvae were evaluated. The results revealed that the insecticidal activity was not significantly enhanced when the heptacycle on the pyrazole ring was reduced to a hexacycle. However, the insertion of an additional methylene spacer between the substituted phenyl ring and the amide bond can improve the insecticidal activity. Among the derivatives, the most potent compound, 6j, exhibited promising insecticidal activities against P. xylostella and S. frugiperda. Further protein binding assays and molecular docking indicated that 6j could target both EcR and OfChtI, and is a potential lead compound for IGRs. The present work provides valuable clues for the development of new dual-target IGRs.
abstract_zh: 蜕皮激素受体（EcR）和几丁质酶在害虫的蜕皮阶段发挥关键作用，两者均被视为开发新型昆虫生长调节剂（IGRs）的有前景靶标。本文在先前发现的能同时作用于EcR和亚洲玉米螟几丁质酶（OfChtI）的双靶标化合物D-27基础上，通过将七元环缩减为六元环并插入小分子柔性连接基，设计并合成了总共24个（其中23个为新化合物）六环吡唑酰胺衍生物。评估了它们对小菜蛾、草地贪夜蛾和亚洲玉米螟幼虫的杀虫活性。结果表明，当吡唑环上的七元环缩减为六元环时，杀虫活性未显著增强。然而，在取代苯环与酰胺键之间插入额外的亚甲基间隔基可提高杀虫活性。在这些衍生物中，最具潜力的化合物6j对小菜蛾和草地贪夜蛾表现出良好的杀虫活性。进一步的蛋白质结合实验和分子对接表明，6j能同时靶向EcR和OfChtI，是IGRs的潜在先导化合物。本研究为开发新型双靶标IGRs提供了有价值的线索。
